edits.after: When these questions are allowed in, introspection ceases to be merely an exercise in managing ourselves.
edits.reason: Replaces awkward administering themselves with natural prose; the contrast with genuine encounter remains.
edits.before: When these questions are allowed in, introspection ceases to be merely a person administering themselves.

edits.after: Cuando estas preguntas encuentran espacio, la introspección deja de ser simplemente una forma de gestionarnos a nosotros mismos.
edits.reason: Repairs the unnatural definition as una persona administrándose; retains self-management versus encounter.
edits.before: Cuando estas preguntas encuentran espacio, la introspección deja de ser simplemente una persona administrándose a sí misma.

edits.after: Como si reprocharnos lo suficiente demostrara que hemos afrontado seriamente el error. Sin embargo, castigarse y asumir responsabilidades no son lo mismo. Alguien puede repetirse por dentro lo terrible que es sin disculparse nunca ante las personas afectadas; también puede pasar toda la noche sintiendo vergüenza sin cambiar nada en su manera de organizarse.
edits.reason: Disposiciones is an unnatural/ambiguous rendering of practical arrangements; preserves the full contrast between self-punishment, apology and practical change.
edits.before: Como si reprocharnos lo suficiente demostrara que hemos afrontado seriamente el error. Sin embargo, castigarse y asumir responsabilidades no son lo mismo. Alguien puede repetirse por dentro lo terrible que es sin disculparse nunca ante las personas afectadas; también puede pasar toda la noche sintiendo vergüenza sin cambiar ninguna de sus disposiciones.

edits.after: La experiencia aún no ha terminado de suceder y ya la estamos interpretando.
edits.reason: Repairs mechanical se la ha llevado a interpretar while preserving premature interpretation before experience unfolds.
edits.before: La experiencia aún no ha terminado de suceder y ya se la ha llevado a interpretar.

edits.after: They can help us arrange our lives: knowing we need quiet, we can leave time after intensive socializing; knowing we are poor at improvising, we can prepare ahead. But they need not go on to declare: therefore I can never speak at an important moment, never form a certain kind of relationship, and should never try a new role.
edits.reason: Restores the final clause's should not, rather than assimilating it to the preceding cannot; practical examples and qualification retained.
edits.before: They can help us arrange our lives: knowing we need quiet, we can leave time after intensive socializing; knowing we are poor at improvising, we can prepare ahead. But they need not go on to declare: therefore I can never speak at an important moment, never form a certain kind of relationship, never try a new role.

edits.after: A good label should therefore remain open to reinterpretation, narrowing, and withdrawal by the person concerned. It helps others understand us; it does not give them permanent authority to act on our behalf.
edits.reason: Naturalizes legalistic power of representation without losing reinterpretation, narrowing, withdrawal or the permanent-proxy warning.
edits.before: A good label should therefore remain open to reinterpretation, narrowing, and withdrawal by the person concerned. It helps others understand; it does not grant permanent power of representation.

edits.after: Por eso, una buena etiqueta debe poder ser reinterpretada, acotada y retirada por la persona interesada. Ayuda a otros a comprendernos; no les da autoridad para actuar en nuestro nombre para siempre.
edits.reason: Clarifies that representation means permanent authority to act for us, not a lasting description; complete three revocation powers retained.
edits.before: Por eso, una buena etiqueta debe poder ser reinterpretada, acotada y retirada por la persona interesada. Ayuda a otros a comprender; no les otorga una representación permanente.

edits.after: No debería dictar qué caminos son los únicos que podemos tomar desde aquí.
edits.reason: Removes awkward hacia dónde, y solo hacia dónde while retaining the warning against prescribing exclusive future possibilities.
edits.before: No debería dictar hacia dónde, y solo hacia dónde, podemos ir desde aquí.

edits.after: Some emotions still cannot be put into words with complete precision.
edits.reason: Naturalizes expression and avoids adding never as an unnecessary timeless absolute.
edits.before: Some emotions will still never be expressed with complete precision.

edits.after: Solo nos permite actuar un poco más despacio y distinguir un poco mejor cuando nos enfrentamos a eso que aún no hemos logrado expresar por completo.
edits.reason: Repairs literal distinguir alrededor de; preserves slower action and finer discernment about what remains unarticulated.
edits.before: Solo nos permite actuar un poco más despacio y distinguir un poco mejor alrededor de eso que aún no se ha dicho por completo.

edits.after: La imagen que los demás tienen de nosotros entra poco a poco en la que tenemos de nosotros mismos.
edits.reason: Repairs plural quienes somos with singular entra and makes the internalized view natural without changing agency.
edits.before: Quienes somos a los ojos de otros entra poco a poco en quienes somos a nuestros propios ojos.

edits.after: La imagen que los demás tienen de nosotros nunca desaparecerá por completo.
edits.reason: Repairs the same plural-subject/singular-verb construction; preserves that others' view never vanishes entirely.
edits.before: Quienes somos a los ojos de otros nunca desaparecerá por completo.

edits.after: Someone long called intelligent may grow increasingly afraid to ask a question they have not fully thought through; someone praised as strong may struggle to admit needing support. A positive mirror can sometimes be harder to put down than criticism because it offers precious recognition.
edits.reason: Replaces unnatural undeveloped question with natural ordinary-reader prose; both praise examples, possibility and recognition explanation retained.
edits.before: Someone long called intelligent may grow increasingly afraid to ask an undeveloped question; someone praised as strong may struggle to admit needing support. A positive mirror can sometimes be harder to put down than criticism because it offers precious recognition.

review_scope.method: Read every Chinese, English and Spanish paragraph from the formal incoming ZIP, comparing meaning, argument, examples and qualifications; checked paragraph alignment against supplied Markdown. Local edits preserve paragraph positions and complete argument.
review_scope.limitations: Editorial and cross-language review, not independent empirical verification of every general claim. No site files edited or incoming scripts executed.
review_scope.truncation_recovery: Initial combined output for essays01–02 was truncated at their boundary; recovered01p40 and02p1–2 in a fresh bounded output. All remaining paragraphs fully visible in bounded outputs; no unread text certified.
